recentItems.description:
Cyclone Arnab has dealt a major blow to farmers in Krishna district, Andhra Pradesh, just days before the paddy crop was expected to be harvested. Strong winds and heavy rain have flattened standing paddy fields, putting months of hard work at risk. Farmers say they have already invested more than ₹30,000 per acre and fear that even salvaging the remaining crop may not cover their expenses.

recentItems.title: అర్నబ్ తుపాను నష్టం రూ.4,600 కోట్లు.. చంద్రబాబు కీలక ప్రకటన
recentItems.description:
Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu stated that Cyclone Arnab caused damage worth more than ₹4,600 crore across the state. During his visit to Cheyyeru in Konaseema district, he met affected residents and said Konaseema and West Godavari were among the worst-hit areas. He stated that electricity restoration was progressing and essential supplies were being distributed. The Chief Minister assured each affected family of a 25 kg bag of rice and financial assistance. He also announced compensation of ₹1,500 for farmers who lost coconut trees.
